title: feat: add GeoSearch widget & connector
body:
This PR adds a GeoSearch connector and a widget implemented with Google Maps.

![screen shot 2018-03-02 at 08 57 46](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6513513/36888905-d2fa487c-1df7-11e8-8e8b-d972cce49b35.png)

**Support**:

* refine on interaction
* control the interaction from the widget
* work out of the box with Places (aka with a GeoCoding widget)
* built-in / HTML marker
* URLSync

**Don't support**:

* InfoWindow / InfoBox out of the box, can be plug (see the examples)
* Widget communication out of the box, can be plug (see the examples)

**Known issue**:

* the docs is far from perfect, don't hesitate to give feedbacks!
* doesn't work with an array for the `_geoloc` attribute, only works with an object
* only work with hits for now (don't work with facets values for example), but we can probably find a solution for that with the connector implementation

**Will change**:

* \~~design & markup: will review the UX/design with the design team. After the design review we should directly integrate the GeoSearch markup in IS.css~~

You can play with the example on [DevNovel](https://deploy-preview-2743--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=GeoSearch.default). Look at the code source of the examples, especially for the InfoWindow, InfoBox & Hits communication. Don't hesitate to give some feedbacks on the behaviour or report bugs!
